items.text: Hello Sunita, Ishita’s weekly summary is ready on your Home page. Happy to talk if anything looks off.

Hi Sunita, Ishita’s free plan has run 9 weeks and her fractions and integers gaps are still open, so the plan now suggests a Maths tutor. Rahul Verma matches her gaps; she can book a free demo from Sessions.
Thank you Heena. Yes, please let her book the demo. We are fine with a paid tutor for a couple of months.
